stock.description: Century Group International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company established in 2001 and based in Sha Tin, Hong Kong, operates primarily as a subcontractor specializing in site preparation across mainland China and Hong Kong. Its business is divided into two main areas: Construction and Site Formation, and Trading. Within its construction segment, the company undertakes a wide array of site formation services. These include comprehensive earthworks such as excavating soil and rock, managing the disposal of construction waste, and performing backfilling and compaction to create new sites or achieve specific formation levels for future construction. It also possesses expertise in tunnel excavation, involving rock removal through drilling, breaking, and blasting techniques, alongside the installation of temporary tunnel support structures. Furthermore, the company provides foundation works, encompassing excavation, lateral support, and related structural tasks for constructing pile caps in commercial and residential developments, in addition to road and drainage infrastructure projects. Beyond its construction activities, the company is involved in the trading of liquefied natural gas (LNG) and various construction materials. Its services are applied to a diverse range of commercial and residential building endeavors. The company was previously known as CHerish Holdings Limited, adopting its current name in February 2019.
